name: How do I choose the right home addition contractor?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right home addition contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a home addition contractor, look for experience, strong communication skills, and a solid reputation. Verify their license and insurance. Request references from previous clients and review their portfolio of similar projects. Obtain multiple bids, ensuring each contractor provides a detailed proposal outlining the scope of work, timeline, and cost breakdown. Trust your instincts and choose someone you feel comfortable working with.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience, good communication, a valid license and insurance, positive references, and detailed project proposals.
